name: Coffee Chat
description: For casual chats, networking, and catch-ups: who you met, what you talked about, what to remember.

sections.title: Who You Spoke With
sections.instruction: Name the person or people, with role/company/affiliation ONLY if they mentioned it in the conversation. Do not fill in details from outside knowledge

sections.title: Topics Discussed
sections.instruction: List the main threads of the conversation, briefly

sections.title: Worth Remembering
sections.instruction: List personal details worth remembering for next time (their projects, interests, life events, preferences) — only things they actually said. If the conversation stayed impersonal, write 'Nothing personal shared'

sections.title: Potential Follow-ups
sections.instruction: List concrete follow-ups that were suggested or promised in the conversation (send that link, make that intro, meet again in a month). Only include follow-ups actually mentioned; if none, write 'None discussed'

sections.title: Favors & Intros
sections.instruction: List anything either side offered or asked for — introductions, referrals, advice, help. If none, write 'None'
